Market Structure · Intermediate

Change in State of Delivery (CISD)

A short-term delivery-change label used when price closes through a chosen opening-price reference from a prior directional candle run. It is a defined close/open observation, not proof of institutional intent.

Open interactive ICT Academy →Official ICT channel ↗Official playlists ↗

How to identify and use this concept

  1. Define the directional candle run and its reference open before reviewing the setup.
  2. For a bullish read, require a candle body close above the chosen bearish-run reference open; for a bearish read, require a body close below the chosen bullish-run reference open.
  3. Record separately whether price also breaks a selected swing; CISD and MSS are not automatically interchangeable.
  4. Predefine invalidation and the next liquidity objective.
Use as a lower-timeframe delivery-shift observation alongside higher-timeframe location and liquidity.

Common mistakes and limitations

Different educators choose the anchor candle differently. A wick through the level is not a body-close confirmation under the common rule. No audited predictive win rate is established.
